x, y, n = map(float, input().split())
n = int(n)

best_numerator = 0
best_denominator = 1

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    ratio = x / y
    floor_value = int((ratio * i) // 1)
    ceil_value = int(-(-ratio * i // 1))  # equivalent to ceil for positive numbers

    if abs(ratio - floor_value / i) < abs(ratio - best_numerator / best_denominator):
        best_numerator = floor_value
        best_denominator = i
    if abs(ratio - ceil_value / i) < abs(ratio - best_numerator / best_denominator):
        best_numerator = ceil_value
        best_denominator = i

print(f"{best_numerator}/{best_denominator}")
